Chinese (Simplified)(zh-CN):
进行移动。

English (United States)(en-US):
Moves.

If moves prior to any action done in this turn, can move freely for 3 grids (Blue).

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-CN):

并在16回合内额外造成{BuffPower}点突刺伤害。
English (United States)(en-US):
Shots and bleeds the target, dealing {HitPower} piercing dmg immediately,
then deals {BuffPower} piercing dmg over 16 turns.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-CN):
消耗大量法力值用星光轰击目标，造成{HitPower}点光属性伤害。
目标获得一层 繁星道标。

繁星道标：
效果持续6回合（可叠加；叠加时刷新持续时间）
星光超流命中受影响的目标时，每层繁星道标都会额外造成{BuffPower}点光属性伤害。
这次伤害的命中较低。

<color=#aa7>繁星编织出的巨隼跨越了银河。</color>
English (United States)(en-US):
Consumes a large amount of mana to bombard the target with starlight, dealing {HitPower} Light damage.
Target gains one stack of Stellar Beacon.

Stellar Beacon:
Effect lasts 6 turns (stackable; duration refreshes when stacked)
When Starlight Pulse hits affected targets, each stack of Stellar Beacon deals an additional {BuffPower} Light damage.
This damage has reduced accuracy.

<color=#aa7>A giant falcon woven from stars crosses the galaxy.</color>

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-CN):

结束回合，并在下{ChargeTime}回合开始时对范围内的每个敌人
造成{HitPower}点斩击伤害。

攻击回合的AP回复减少{APRegenDecrease}点。
攻击算作行动，所以当回合将不能进行免费移动。
English (United States)(en-US):
Charges power for the next devastating strike.
End turn, and at the start of the next {ChargeTime} turn, deal {HitPower} slashing damage to each enemy in range.

AP regeneration is reduced by {APRegenDecrease} on the attack turn.
The attack counts as an action, so no free movement on that turn.
